# Assets · Icons

29 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

These are the glyphs `Icyre.Icon` and every `icon=` prop render — mount the component wherever the bundle runs; the files are for surfaces without it (a deck).

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for play.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

ICYRE line icons: 24×24, 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins, drawn in ink `#141821` (text-primary). In product code use the `Icon` component so glyphs inherit `currentColor`; these SVGs are for design tools and non-React surfaces. Filled variants (play, pause, heart, spark) come from the component's `filled` prop.
